<InstallBlock name="changelog-video" />

**Changelog Video** is a release update driven entirely by props: a stamp with
your product name, version and date, one beat per change, and a closing beat
with the full changelog URL. The frame stays the same every release; only the
data changes. That is what lets you render it from a GitHub Actions workflow
with `npx remotion render --props`, without touching the code.

With three items it runs **630 frames at 30 fps, 1920×1080, 21 seconds**. Each
extra item adds 4.5 seconds, up to eight items. The step-by-step setup for
rendering it on every release is in the
[Changelog video guide](/docs/guides/changelog-video).

## Usage

```tsx
// src/Root.tsx
import { Composition } from "remotion";
import {
  ChangelogVideo,
  calculateChangelogVideoMetadata,
  changelogVideoDefaults,
  CHANGELOG_VIDEO_FPS,
  CHANGELOG_VIDEO_HEIGHT,
  CHANGELOG_VIDEO_WIDTH,
} from "@/components/remocn/templates/changelog-video";

export const RemotionRoot = () => (
  <Composition
    id="ChangelogVideo"
    component={ChangelogVideo}
    durationInFrames={630}
    calculateMetadata={calculateChangelogVideoMetadata}
    fps={CHANGELOG_VIDEO_FPS}
    width={CHANGELOG_VIDEO_WIDTH}
    height={CHANGELOG_VIDEO_HEIGHT}
    defaultProps={changelogVideoDefaults}
  />
);
```

`calculateMetadata` sets the length from the number of items, so a release
with five changes renders a longer video than one with two.

## Props

```json
{
  "product": "Northwind",
  "version": "v2.4.0",
  "date": "Nov 9, 2026",
  "items": [
    { "title": "Dark mode", "payoff": "Easy on the eyes at night" },
    { "title": "CSV export", "payoff": "Every report, one click" },
    { "title": "Faster search", "payoff": "Results in under 100 ms" }
  ],
  "url": "northwind.example/changelog",
  "closing": "Shipping every week.",
  "accent": "#7CC4A4",
  "theme": "dark"
}
```

Every prop is plain JSON, so the same object works in `defaultProps`, in a
`props.json` file and in `npx remotion render --props=./props.json`.

| Prop | Default / behavior |
| --- | --- |
| `product` | `"Northwind"`; on the stamp and the closing beat |
| `version` | `"v2.4.0"`; an empty string hides it |
| `date` | `"Nov 9, 2026"`; printed as written, an empty string hides it |
| `items` | `{ title, payoff }[]`; one 4.5-second beat each, up to 8. Blank titles are dropped; an empty list falls back to the defaults |
| `url` | `"northwind.example/changelog"`; an empty string hides it |
| `closing` | `"Shipping every week."`; an empty string hides it |
| `accent` | `"#7CC4A4"`; counter, rule, progress and URL |
| `theme` | `"dark"` or `"light"` |

Keep each `title` to a few words and each `payoff` to six words or fewer.
Longer lines shrink to fit, but short ones read better at speed.
[Words on screen](/docs/guides/words-on-screen) has the rules of thumb.

## Timeline

| Beat | Frames (30 fps) | Time |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Stamp: product, version, date | 0–104 | 0–3.5 s |
| One beat per item | 135 frames each | 4.5 s each |
| Closing: product, closing line, URL | last 120 | 4 s |

The layout is designed at 1920×1080 and scales uniformly to other sizes; it
does not reflow to portrait. Fonts are Manrope and JetBrains Mono through
`@remotion/google-fonts`. No footage, audio or images are included.
